description: New gyms from the batch-5 review follow-ups (checked 2026-10-04): Treadstone Climbing (moved from Columbus GA to 400 Brickyard Rd, Phenix City AL; the old record is retired), Rockstar Climbing Centre (Radway Road, Swindon; Flashpoint Swindon became its Techno site), BOULBAKA2 (Urasoe; the Naha gym is retired), Boulder Base Bremen Tabakquartier (second hall of a one-record pair). Addresses from the official sites; pins from OpenStreetMap or Japan's GSI geocoder (named per record).
